attempt.command: section \<open>Inner Product Spaces and Gradient Derivative\<close>
text \<open> Temporarily relax type constraints for \<^term>\<open>open\<close>, \<^term>\<open>uniformity\<close>, \<^term>\<open>dist\<close>, and \<^term>\<open>norm\<close>. \<close>

class real_inner = real_vector + sgn_div_norm + dist_norm + uniformity_dist + open_uniformity + fixes inner :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real" assumes inner_commute: "inner x y = inner y x" and inner_add_left: "inner (x + y) z = inner x z + inner y z" and inner_scaleR_left [simp]: "inner (scaleR r x) y = r * (inner x y)" and inner_ge_zero [simp]: "0 \<le> inner x x" and inner_eq_zero_iff [simp]: "inner x x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0" and norm_eq_sqrt_inner: "norm x = sqrt (inner x x)" begin
lemma inner_minus_left [simp]: "inner (- x) y = - inner x y"
lemma inner_diff_left: "inner (x - y) z = inner x z - inner y z"
lemma inner_sum_left: "inner (\<Sum>x\<in>A. f x) y = (\<Sum>x\<in>A. inner (f x) y)"
text \<open>Transfer distributivity rules to right argument.\<close>
lemma inner_add_right: "inner x (y + z) = inner x y + inner x z"
lemma inner_scaleR_right [simp]: "inner x (scaleR r y) = r * (inner x y)"
lemma inner_minus_right [simp]: "inner x (- y) = - inner x y"
lemma inner_diff_right: "inner x (y - z) = inner x y - inner x z"
lemma inner_sum_right: "inner x (\<Sum>y\<in>A. f y) = (\<Sum>y\<in>A. inner x (f y))"
lemma inner_gt_zero_iff [simp]: "0 < inner x x \<longleftrightarrow> x \<noteq> 0"
lemma power2_norm_eq_inner: "(norm x)\<^sup>2 = inner x x"
text \<open>Identities involving real multiplication and division.\<close>
lemma inner_mult_left: "inner (of_real m * a) b = m * (inner a b)"
lemma inner_mult_right: "inner a (of_real m * b) = m * (inner a b)"
lemma inner_mult_left': "inner (a * of_real m) b = m * (inner a b)"
lemma inner_mult_right': "inner a (b * of_real m) = (inner a b) * m"
lemma Cauchy_Schwarz_ineq: "(inner x y)\<^sup>2 \<le> inner x x * inner y y"
lemma Cauchy_Schwarz_ineq2: "\<bar>inner x y\<bar> \<le> norm x * norm y"
lemma norm_cauchy_schwarz: "inner x y \<le> norm x * norm y"
lemma square_bound_lemma: fixes x :: real shows "x < (1 + x) * (1 + x)"
lemma square_continuous: fixes e :: real shows "e > 0 \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>d. 0 < d \<and> (\<forall>y. \<bar>y - x\<bar> < d \<longrightarrow> \<bar>y * y - x * x\<bar> < e)"
lemma norm_le: "norm x \<le> norm y \<longleftrightarrow> inner x x \<le> inner y y"
lemma norm_lt: "norm x < norm y \<longleftrightarrow> inner x x < inner y y"
lemma norm_eq: "norm x = norm y \<longleftrightarrow> inner x x = inner y y"
lemma norm_eq_1: "norm x = 1 \<longleftrightarrow> inner x x = 1"
lemma inner_divide_left: fixes a :: "'a :: {real_inner,real_div_algebra}" shows "inner (a / of_real m) b = (inner a b) / m"
lemma inner_divide_right: fixes a :: "'a :: {real_inner,real_div_algebra}" shows "inner a (b / of_real m) = (inner a b) / m"
lemma differentiable_inner [simp]: "f differentiable (at x within s) \<Longrightarrow> g differentiable at x within s \<Longrightarrow> (\<lambda>x. inner (f x) (g x)) differentiable at x within s"
lemma shows real_inner_1_left[simp]: "inner 1 x = x" and real_inner_1_right[simp]: "inner x 1 = x"
definition inner_complex_def: "inner x y = Re x * Re y + Im x * Im y"
lemma norm_eq_square: "norm x = a \<longleftrightarrow> 0 \<le> a \<and> inner x x = a\<^sup>2"
lemma norm_le_square: "norm x \<le> a \<longleftrightarrow> 0 \<le> a \<and> inner x x \<le> a\<^sup>2"
lemma norm_ge_square: "norm x \<ge> a \<longleftrightarrow> a \<le> 0 \<or> inner x x \<ge> a\<^sup>2"
lemma norm_lt_square: "norm x < a \<longleftrightarrow> 0 < a \<and> inner x x < a\<^sup>2"
lemma norm_gt_square: "norm x > a \<longleftrightarrow> a < 0 \<or> inner x x > a\<^sup>2"
text\<open>Dot product in terms of the norm rather than conversely.\<close>
lemmas inner_simps = inner_add_left inner_add_right inner_diff_right inner_diff_left inner_scaleR_left inner_scaleR_right
lemma dot_norm: "inner x y = ((norm (x + y))\<^sup>2 - (norm x)\<^sup>2 - (norm y)\<^sup>2) / 2"
